The "StarCraft" series has challenged the shooting game genre twice before, making old players dream about it. "StarCraft: Ghost" was canceled in 2006, and the "Ares" project using the "Overwatch" engine was canceled in 2019. The real-time strategy type "StarCraft 2" was launched in 2003 and was not released until 2010. DLC updates will be stopped in 2020. Since then, players generally believe that there will be no "StarCraft 3". Can Blizzard break the sequel curse of the "StarCraft" series and let the new shooting game finally be released? This is the topic that players are most concerned about after this carnival. ■ Shadow of the Phantom In 1998, Blizzard released the original "StarCraft". This classic real-time strategy game became popular all over the world as soon as it was released.
